title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 10 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 10 February 2026 Mainly dry weather will prevail in the most parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva, North-central and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
